column1: The Licensee shall at all times ensure that any food sold on the premises is a hazard free food.

column2: No person shall store or sell frozen meat or fish in any premises except in accordance with the following rules.
All frozen meat and fish should be stored after receiving, and in the event that they are not sold, the room
or cabinet should be kept below 2 degrees Celsius as soon as practicable. In all cases, frozen meat and fish
should be preserved to avoid spoilage and combustion.
The surface area of tables, benches or shelves that come in direct contact with frozen meat or fish should
be smooth and free of stains.
